info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Business Analysi By Param1-spec
info.description: The Business Analysis Update API allows users to modify existing business analysis records within the product portfolio based on specific parameters. By utilizing the PATCH method, stakeholders can efficiently update business insights tied to their unique identifiers. This endpoint is designed for financial analysts and business managers who need to keep their portfolio analysis up-to-date with the latest data. The API streamlines the updating process, ensuring that valuable information is accurately reflected in real-time.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update specific details of the product portfolio identified by PROD-700045. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields that need to be changed in your request.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to update the product portfolio for the specified product ID (PROD-700045). The JSON object should contain the fields that need to be modified with their corresponding new values.
